title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Prompt-Pay Discount Calculation
content:
**Cash posting calculation note — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.**

**Formal clause.** The prompt-pay discount is the prompt-pay rate, taken as a percentage, of the amount of the charge the qualifying payment paid in full, rounded to the cent half up. The prompt-pay rate is the class's prompt-pay discount percentage, as listed for the payer class in the prompt-pay terms.

## The payment and the charge

The discount figured is the one for the account's most recent patient-payment entry and the account's most recently posted coinsurance charge. It is 0.00, and nothing is posted, when:

- that entry is smaller than that charge; or
- that entry was posted before the latest statement issued on the account; or
- that entry was posted more than the class's prompt-pay window, in calendar days, after the latest statement.

A class whose prompt-pay discount percentage is 0 grants none: the discount is 0.00.

## Condition table

| Entry amount compared with the charge | Days from the latest statement to the entry's posting date | Class percentage | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| at least the charge | 0 up to the window, both ends included | above 0 | rate of the charge amount |
| at least the charge | more than the window | above 0 | 0.00 |
| at least the charge | entry posted before the statement | above 0 | 0.00 |
| smaller than the charge | any | above 0 | 0.00 |
| any | any | 0 | 0.00 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Commercial PPO account (prompt-pay percentage 5, window 30 days). Latest statement issued on day 0; most recently posted coinsurance charge 186.40; most recent patient-payment entry 186.40 posted on day 12.

1. Entry not smaller than the charge; posted 12 days after the statement, within 30: the payment qualifies.
2. Prompt-pay rate: 5.
3. 5 percent of 186.40 is 9.32. Discount **9.32**.

Had the same entry posted on day 31, the discount would be 0.00. On a Medicare Advantage HMO account, whose percentage is 0, the discount is 0.00 whatever the timing.
